row.notes: thunk=jmp to .data1 body 0x155755570 (plaintext on Steam). 9-arg layout (V0246, V0313): rcx=*(ws+0x1da8) TOD owner (TOD=*(owner+0x2d0)), rdx=u8 engine types[6] (clear..stormy, 0x145bf6358), r8=f32 hold s[6], r9=f32 transition s[6], [rsp+20]=u8 random[6], [rsp+28]=u32 count, [rsp+30]=f32 dataset length s, [rsp+38]=u16 0x100|dataset (<0x100 = all 10 datasets, 0x14588c605), [rsp+40]=u8 use_count flag (0 = one state, else min(count,6)). Body sets TOD+0xb350+s*4 = len and TOD+0x34c+s*0x288 = max(len,0.01), then 0x14461bb70 -> body 0x155254f20, which does nothing if TOD+0xb432 is set or TOD+0xb429/+0xb42a is clear, else Tod_Build_WeatherScenario 0x14461bea0(tod,types,hold,trans,random,count,s,use,0), except that with TOD+0xb436 set it diverts when TOD+0xb42d is set (random 1..6-state build with null hold/trans) or else when TOD+0x2654 is set (0x14461b3d0); with +0xb436 set and both clear it runs the normal build (V0313). With TOD+0xb426 set and both arrays non-null: state end=(acc+hold)/len, trans=trans/len, no extra states. Callers: setupSession (2 sites) and 0x1428c1ce0 (frontend scene: dataset 0 clear). career-editor checks the same gates (TimeOfDaySystem busy, ready_a/ready_b, override_active && (random_override || scripted_scenario)) before calling and reports not_applied with the reason.  | std-libs 2026-11-18 (static, Steam 1.0.145, for the core weather rebuild): the thunk 0x14479f0d0 jumps to body 0x154e5da90. Against KB body 0x155755570 the first 58 instructions are equal, with +0xb350 (4 uses), +0x34c (4) and owner+0x2d0 at the same instructions. Its gate thunk 0x14461e3e0 jumps to 0x15494af60; against KB 0x155254f20, +0xb432 (3 uses), +0xb429, +0xb42a, +0xb436, +0xb42d, +0x2654 and the +0xb427 store sit at the same instructions in the same order (1.0.145 adds protector filler, 44/101 equal overall). Tod_Build_WeatherScenario 0x14461bea0 -> 0x14461e710: 783/783 equal, +0xb426 2 uses at the same place (sigport --witness). sigport finds no unique pattern for the .data1 bodies, so they were compared by following the jmps (scratch bodycmp.py, rip and branch targets masked).
